summary: Youxin Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing audited financial statements of Celnet Technology Co., Ltd. and unaudited pro forma financial information related to its previously completed acquisition of a 51% equity interest in Celnet. The acquisition was announced on September 22, 2025, and closed on October 29, 2025. No new deal terms, prices, or recommendations are disclosed in this filing. The filing is a routine post-closing financial statement submission, not a new special situation. As a non-US filer, Form 6-K is equivalent to a current report on Form 8-K. Watch for no further regulatory or risk-arb events.
